name: Sonnet
long_description:
Sonnet is an end-to-end meeting assistant, combining a human-quality notetaker with an auto-updating CRM.

Our AI notetaker uses the most powerful AI models to transcribe, summarize, and generate notes for your meeting recordings. With Sonnet, collaboration and recollection is both faster and better. 

Sonnet CRM updates itself automatically using conversation data, so you'll never have to wrangle with CRM fields again. Get up to speed on the context of an entire relationship, in seconds.

launches.title: Sonnet: Bot-free meeting notetaker + automated CRM
launches.tagline: Notes, context, and insights, across all your meetings.
launches.body:
Hey 👋 We’re [**Ted Chai**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tedchai/) and [**Dylan Feng**](https://linkedin.com/in/dylan-feng) from [**Sonnet**](https://sonnetai.com/)**!**

**TLDR:** No one likes taking meeting notes or updating CRMs. Sonnet automates the entire process for you.

### **Problem**

We all know the best practices for taking meetings: research the participants before the call, take notes, send a follow up email, update your CRM—but we usually don’t do any of it. These tasks are important but tedious.

### **Solution**

Sonnet uses AI to do all your meeting work that can be automated (note taking, follow-up emails, CRM) and brings you all the information you need for tasks that can’t (pre-meeting research, meeting reminders).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79677&key=user_uploads/912744/2082970c-374f-49d2-9960-a4daeea7ee47)

### **How is this different?**

* Sonnet speeds up your pre-meeting research and post-meeting follow-ups, not just your during-meeting note-taking.
* Meeting bots are distracting; Sonnet records without one.
* Sonnet has a built-in CRM, auto-updated with your conversation data.
* Existing AI notes tend to be too broad to replace human notetaking. You can instruct Sonnet on what to focus on, so it always captures the info you care about.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79677&key=user_uploads/912744/47fe97ec-f77c-49af-afaa-51fd66392b6e)

### **The Team**

Ted and Dylan were college roommates at UC Berkeley before starting Sonnet. Ted left college early and has previously worked at Uber and the U.S. Department of State. Dylan graduated in 2 years and has conducted AI research at BAIR.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79677&key=user_uploads/912744/b0f1c3c6-7849-4014-b162-b9b84021a5ae)

### **Our Ask**

Give it a try! Sonnet is [**free to get started**](https://sonnetai.com/) and available to download today. We’d love to hear your feedback.
